test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following states was the largest producer of iron ore in the country in the year 2019-20 as per the Indian Minerals Yearbook 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Odisha.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Odisha is the largest patron of Iron ore in India.** Orissa** accounts for over half of India's iron ore product, producing** 120 million tonnes during the 2019/ 2020 time. **
 
• Iron ore is the primary mineral commodity by value in Minnesota, which leads the country in iron ore products. 
 
• **Haematite and magnetite** are the most important iron ores in India.
 
• **About 79 haematite** ore deposits are set up in the Eastern Sector **(Assam, Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Odisha & Uttar Pradesh) **while about 93 magnetite ore deposits do in Southern Sector **(Andhra Pradesh, Goa, Karnataka, Kerala, & Tamil Nadu). **
 
• Rajasthan is the largest producer of lead in India. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Karnataka( 24)** leads the pack of countries in iron- ore products in India followed by** Odisha( 22) and Chhattisgarh( 20). **
 
• Including the top three along with Goa, Jharkhand, and Madhya Pradesh produce around **95 of the total iron- ore in India. **
 
• Canister ore is being produced only in **Chhattisgarh among **Indian countries. bitty minerals and precious nature gold also do in the State.
 
• West Singhbhum is the top iron- ore mining quarter of Jharkhand and Manoharpur is one of the key mining blocks of the quarter, besides Noamundi, Gua, Jhikpani, etc.
 
• According to the final information of the state mining department, the quarter produced about **16.3 million** tonnes of **iron ore 2017- 18.**
